strategy: v0-nowar + keep rule with tuned, opponent-scaled draw bonuses (strategy/03 S3.1 + S3.3)

PUSHFOLD_BB.note: push/fold at or below this many BB

PUSH_MARGINAL_BB.note: class-1 hands shove unopened at or below this

OPEN_PREMIUM_BB.note: open size (BB) with class 3; also the 3-bet floor

THREEBET_MULT.note: 3-bet to this multiple of the amount to call

CALL_GOOD_MAX_BB.note: class 2 calls a single open up to this many BB

CALL_MID_PAIR_FRAC.note: TT-JJ call a 3-bet up to this share of stack

CALL_LOW_PAIR_FRAC.note: 77-99 call a 3-bet up to this share of stack

LIMP_MARGINAL_BB.note: class 1 limps when to_call <= this * bb

STRONG_BET_POT.note: bet size (pot fraction) with two pair+

STRONG_CALL_POT.note: two pair raises a bet up to this * pot, calls above

MEDIUM_CALL_POT.note: top pair calls up to this * pot

WEAK_CALL_POT.note: any pair calls up to this * pot

FD_CALL_POT.note: flush draw calls up to this * pot

CBET_MIN_RANK.note: c-bet needs a hole card of this rank (9 = J, 13 = never)

EXPOSE_LOW_PROB.note: P(expose the weaker kept card); strategy/03 S3.2

W1_FD.note: draw bonus (M units) for FD with <=2 live opponents

W1_FD1.note: draw bonus (M units) for FD1 with <=2 live opponents

W1_OESD.note: draw bonus (M units) for OESD with <=2 live opponents

W1_GUT.note: draw bonus (M units) for GUT with <=2 live opponents

W1_OVER.note: draw bonus (M units) for OVER with <=2 live opponents

W3_FD.note: draw bonus (M units) for FD with 3-4 live opponents

W3_FD1.note: draw bonus (M units) for FD1 with 3-4 live opponents

W3_OESD.note: draw bonus (M units) for OESD with 3-4 live opponents

W3_GUT.note: draw bonus (M units) for GUT with 3-4 live opponents

W3_OVER.note: draw bonus (M units) for OVER with 3-4 live opponents

W6_FD.note: draw bonus (M units) for FD with >=5 live opponents

W6_FD1.note: draw bonus (M units) for FD1 with >=5 live opponents

W6_OESD.note: draw bonus (M units) for OESD with >=5 live opponents

W6_GUT.note: draw bonus (M units) for GUT with >=5 live opponents

W6_OVER.note: draw bonus (M units) for OVER with >=5 live opponents
